title: Canon cites the ruling's source artifact at a repo-relative path that does not exist in the repository
evidence:
decision-log.md:735-736: "- **Origin:** the surge-explainer (§Section B design notes, artifact
  `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/surge-explainer/surge-explainer.html`)"; spec-traffic-model.md:7: "networks. Primary source artifact: `surge-explainer.html` §B (the \"Your design — narrow as"; stories-v2.md:640: "networks — at aggregation points, never at endpoints. Source: `surge-explainer.html` §B (the". Verification at the reviewed sha: `git ls-files _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/` lists 17 files with no surge-explainer/ entry; `find . -name "*surge*" -not -path "./.git/*"` returns only spec-4-2-surge-crisis.md, goldens/, demos/; `git log --all --diff-filter=A -- "*surge-explainer*"` is empty — the file exists only outside the repo, at /Users/moses/code/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/surge-explainer/surge-explainer.html.
detail: The canonized ruling's primary source is unreachable from the repository. Every sibling artifact in that tracked directory is committed; repo-only readers cannot follow the provenance link the decision log records.
recommended_fix: Commit surge-explainer.html under the cited path, or amend the three citations to the artifact's actual external location (or inline the §B numbers) so the provenance chain resolves.

title: "One deliberate re-bless at the slice boundary" contradicts the four per-card re-blesses the cards themselves mandate
evidence:
spec-traffic-model.md:244-246: "or catalog data — no wall-clock anywhere; replay stays byte-identical with **one deliberate,
cause-documented re-bless** at the slice boundary (all four threads shift the (class, src, dst)
spawn stream and/or the catalog hash)."; but stories-v2.md:671: "unchanged. **Golden:** T1 (spawn sequence shift — **deliberate, cause-documented re-bless** per the"; stories-v2.md:696: "**Golden:** T1/T2 re-bless (cause-documented, the slice boundary's legitimate re-bless)."; stories-v2.md:720: "alone. **Golden:** T1/T2 re-bless + a T2 frame with all three types visible."; stories-v2.md:755-756: "`[E9]`/`[E22]` unchanged. **Golden:** T1/T2 re-bless + a T2 frame of a clustered topology"; and 5.10 is itself a catalog change (pipe_tiers.json 5 → ~8-10) that folds cat.hash immediately.

title: Story 5.9 places the director's spawn pass in demand.odin; the pass lives in flow.odin §1b
detail: demand.odin is structurally topology-blind (no Run_State, no terminals); the cap needs live topology plus per-tick spawn counts, which exist only in flow_step's pass. The Systems line points the implementing minion at the wrong module.
recommended_fix: Reword 5.9's Systems line to "flow.odin §1b director spawn pass (flow_step's consumer of the ODN-7 plan), catalogs [ODN-5]".

title: Aggregation-group membership is consumed by two modules but no derivation owner is pinned
evidence:
spec-traffic-model.md:186-190: "**Determinism constraints:** groups are derived from the seed (growth placement draws + the type
pick) + the live topology — fully seed-derived, no wall-clock, no log entries (growth is already
log-free; the bias extends the same derive-don't-record rule). T1 shifts (spawn sequence + topology)
→ deliberate re-bless."; stories-v2.md:742-743: "**Systems:** growth (5.1 group-bias draw), director
`[ODN-7]` (group-scoped demand weight), crisis Surge (S4)."; the codebase precedent for shared derived state, flow.odin:596-598: "they are never serialized and replay recomputes them identically). The"
detail: Growth's bias draw and the director's group weight both need cluster membership. With no named owner, each re-derives clustering independently — duplicated logic that can silently diverge from one canon concept.
recommended_fix: Pin one shared derived groups view (recomputed on topology gen — the lane_caps pattern at flow.odin:596-613) consumed by both the growth bias and the demand weight.
